  • realities. Matter or the particulars are also considered as having reality with a
  • secondary states.

  • ethics.founding a way of life based on numbers rather not just tools for
  • measurements-metaphysics of numbers-musical harmony-the transmigration of
  • souls-rigorous self-discipline etc.
